Description: This function resets the present value for number of cards retained to zero. The function is possible for motor-driven card readers only. The number of cards retained is controlled by the service and can be requested before resetting via the WFS_INF_IDC_STATUS.

OutputParam.Value: None. Error Codes Only the generic error codes defined in [Ref. 1] can be generated by this command. Events In addition to the generic events defined in [Ref.1], the following events can be generated by this command: Value Meaning
